purpose.zh: 把从 Google 地图发现目标企业、官网研究、公开联系方式获取、定制邮件准备到发送与回复跟进，接成一套可部署的销售开发系统。
purpose.en: Connect Google Maps company discovery, official-site research, public-contact discovery, personalized message preparation, sending, and reply follow-up in one deployable sales-development system.

originalWorkflow.zh: 销售人员按关键词和地区在 Google 地图寻找目标企业，逐个确认官网并整理名单。
originalWorkflow.en: Sales teams searched Google Maps by keyword and region, verified each official website, and assembled prospect lists.

originalWorkflow.zh: 找到企业后，还要逐家阅读官网、寻找公开联系方式，再根据对方业务单独准备开发邮件。
originalWorkflow.en: After finding a company, the team still had to read its website, locate public contacts, and prepare an outreach message for that specific business.

workflowBreakpoints.zh: 从地图搜索到官网研究包含大量重复操作，名单扩大后很难保持同样的研究深度。
workflowBreakpoints.en: Moving from map search to website research required repetitive work, making it difficult to keep the same research depth as the list grew.

workflowBreakpoints.zh: 统一群发模板无法利用每家企业官网里的具体业务信息，逐封人工写信又很难持续。
workflowBreakpoints.en: A generic template ignored the specific business context on each website, while writing every message by hand was difficult to sustain.

workflowBreakpoints.zh: 企业来源、官网内容、联系方式、邮件草稿和发送状态分散，销售难以统一审核和继续跟进。
workflowBreakpoints.en: Company sources, website context, contacts, message drafts, and send status were scattered, making review and follow-up difficult.

systemBoundary.zh: 系统在客户控制的 Docker 环境中处理 Google 地图企业数据与公开官网信息。真实发送前必须经过人工审核和发送计划确认。
systemBoundary.en: The system processes Google Maps company data and public website information in a customer-controlled Docker environment. Real delivery requires human review and send-plan confirmation.

inputs.zh: Google 地图搜索关键词、目标地区和采集任务
inputs.en: Google Maps search keywords, target regions, and collection tasks

inputs.zh: Google 地图返回的企业名称、地址、官网等公开字段
inputs.en: Public Google Maps fields such as company name, address, and official website

inputs.zh: 企业官网公开内容，以及发件方的业务资料和营销要求
inputs.en: Public official-site content plus the sender's business profile and outreach requirements

processing.zh: 按关键词和地区从 Google 地图采集目标企业，并保留企业来源与官网
processing.en: Collect target companies from Google Maps by keyword and region while preserving source and official-site information

processing.zh: 逐家访问官网，提取业务介绍、服务信息与公开联系方式
processing.en: Visit each official website to extract business descriptions, service information, and public contacts

processing.zh: 结合对方官网内容和发件方资料生成定制开发邮件，进入人工审核与发送计划
processing.en: Use the prospect's website context and sender profile to generate a personalized message for human review and send planning

humanReview.zh: 逐条确认目标企业、官网内容、公开联系方式和定制邮件是否准确
humanReview.en: Review the target company, website context, public contacts, and personalized message for accuracy

humanReview.zh: 人工决定是否修改、发送、安排节奏或停止联系，并处理后续回复
humanReview.en: A human decides whether to edit, send, schedule, or stop contact and handles subsequent replies

outputs.zh: 包含企业来源、官网、公开联系方式和处理状态的目标客户库
outputs.en: A prospect library containing source, official website, public contacts, and processing status

outputs.zh: 依据每家企业官网内容生成、可逐条审核的定制开发邮件
outputs.en: A reviewable personalized outreach message generated from each company's website context

outputs.zh: 带发送节奏、发件账号、投递状态和回复跟进的发送计划
outputs.en: Send plans with pacing, sender account, delivery status, and reply follow-up

failureRecovery.zh: 无效记录不会被删除，而是保留明确原因供复核。
failureRecovery.en: Invalid records are preserved with explicit reasons instead of being deleted.

failureRecovery.zh: 批次支持暂停、恢复、重试、事件日志和重复文件保护。
failureRecovery.en: Batches support pause, resume, retry, event logs, and duplicate-file protection.

currentStatus.zh: 项目已形成可独立部署的 Docker 系统，覆盖 Google 地图企业发现、逐家官网分析、公开联系方式提取、定制邮件生成、人工审核、发送计划和回复监控。
currentStatus.en: The project is a self-contained Docker system covering Google Maps company discovery, official-site analysis, public-contact extraction, personalized message generation, human review, send plans, and reply monitoring.

transferableCapabilities.zh: 把 Google 地图搜索结果持续转成可研究、可联系的目标企业库
transferableCapabilities.en: Continuously turn Google Maps results into a prospect library ready for research and contact

transferableCapabilities.zh: 利用每家企业官网的真实业务内容准备定制营销信息
transferableCapabilities.en: Use real business context from each official website to prepare personalized outreach

transferableCapabilities.zh: 把企业研究、内容审核、发送节奏和回复跟进放在同一条流程里
transferableCapabilities.en: Keep company research, content review, sending pace, and reply follow-up in one workflow

transferableCapabilities.zh: 以镜像化部署交付客户可独立运行的系统
transferableCapabilities.en: Deliver a customer-operated system through image-based deployment

description.zh: 展示从 Google 地图企业发现、官网研究、定制内容生成到人工审核和发送计划的完整流程。
description.en: Shows the full workflow from Google Maps company discovery and website research to personalized content, human review, and send planning.

description.zh: 服务、API、前端、企业数据处理、发送安全与移动端可以沿同一条流程验收。
description.en: Services, API, frontend, company-data processing, send safety, and mobile behavior can be accepted through one workflow.

limitations.zh: 只处理公开企业信息，不抓取登录后页面或个人资料。
limitations.en: Processes public business information only; it does not crawl authenticated pages or personal profiles.

limitations.zh: 外联内容必须人工审核，系统不提供无差别批量自动发送。
limitations.en: Outreach content requires human review; the system does not provide indiscriminate automated bulk sending.

alt.zh: Freight Lead Agent 批次处理与人工审核界面
alt.en: Freight Lead Agent batch processing and human-review interface
